summary: Beyond Air, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting that the Nasdaq Hearings Panel granted its request for continued listing, subject to demonstrating compliance with the Bid Price Rule by July 31, 2026. The decision follows a May 14, 2026 hearing where the company presented its compliance plan. Upon regaining compliance, a one-year discretionary panel monitor will apply; any future listing failure during that period will result in immediate delisting without a plan submission. A press release was issued June 1, 2026. This is a routine Nasdaq compliance update, not a special situation.
